config.upstream_semantics: Each relaxed chemical candidate is a topology seed. Its mapped Factor 1 lipid loading is retained as assignment-level sign-consistency evidence, not as a propagated activity or dose.
config.downstream_semantics: All finite nonzero Factor 1 hepatocyte TF footprint activities; the abs(activity)>2 panel is a labelled observation-set sensitivity.
config.pkn_semantics: Only direct chemical-to-protein and protein-to-protein edges from the directional-STITCH exploratory PKN are used. Reaction edges are excluded.
limitations: A relaxed chemical candidate can resolve unmeasured double-bond position, geometry, stereochemistry, sn position, or acid/base state.
One measured lipid can map to multiple chemicals, and related chemical candidates can share direct regulatory edge fingerprints.
MOON scores are generated from TF activities and PKN topology; copied Factor 1 lipid loadings are post-score annotations rather than independent score evidence.
Measured bulk-liver lipid abundance does not establish hepatocyte ligand exposure, receptor engagement, or temporal ordering.
The directional STITCH v5 source files are historical, and all candidate routes remain exploratory mechanistic hypotheses.
